description: For owners: apply to list a vacation rental on Guest2Host (free, no commission, never takes payments). Needs four things: the property name, its town and state, the owner's own booking-site link and the owner's email. The owner gets a confirmation email with a status link (also returned here); once the Guest2Host team approves it (usually within a business day) the listing is built from their booking site and put live, and they are emailed the link — a sign-in only if they want to edit it. Use only with the owner's agreement.

directBookingUrl.description: The owner's own booking site (https) — the page for this home if there is one. Required unless wantsSiteBuild is true

ownerEmail.description: Where the confirmation and the sign-in invite go

wantsSiteBuild.description: No booking site yet and would like Guest2Host to build one (paid)

name: apply_to_list
title: Apply to list a rental
